card.title: 5th RANGERS

card.flavorText: The 5th Ranger Infantry Battalion was activated in 1943 and was one of seven Ranger Battalions that were raised during WWII. The 5th Rangers landed on Omaha Beach along with companies A, B and C of the 2nd Rangers, where elements of the 116th Infantry Regiment had been pinned down by heavy enemy fire from the heights above. Despite heavy casualties the Rangers managed to advance across the seawall and barbed wire and to knock out the enemy positions. The Rangers then managed to advance 6 km inland to the village of Vierville-sur-Mer and by doing so they opened the breach for the supporting troops to follow up and expand the beachhead. The 5th Ranger Battalion would later distinguish itself in numerous battles and operations in Europe, including the Battle for Brest, the Battle of Hürtgen Forest and the Battle of the Bulge.
